title: TWLM - POS
subtitle: Point of Sale System with Loyalty & Wallet Integrations
description: TWLM - POS – Comprehensive Point of Sale System
A comprehensive POS and CMS platform for businesses — Gulf tax integrations, inventory, loyalty, gift cards, customizable e-menu storefronts, and 30+ CMS features. B2B2C.
Improved the overall UI/UX, making features more intuitive and user-friendly, which reduced support center requests by approximately 70%.

Designed and developed loyalty program features including a Loyalty Points System, Loyalty Cards, a Gift Card System with Apple Wallet and Google Wallet integration, and real-time notification support.
Built a centralized promotional messaging system with Apple Wallet loyalty passes, smart geo-location targeting, and branch-based tracking and visibility.
Developed a dynamic Page Builder and a Flutter-based mobile application that allows businesses to create customizable storefront pages and enables customers to place orders online easily.
Optimized backend APIs, reducing latency by approximately 64% and improving system performance.
Used Prisma ORM with PostgreSQL for schema migrations and faster data access; added RBAC with OAuth2/JWT and SSO for multi-role access.
Built webhook-driven workflows for wallet updates and notifications, and integrated CRM plus Gulf payment gateways (MyFatoorah, Moyasar).
Spearheaded OpenRouter AI (DeepSeek) integration for smart menu search and AI-based analysis of restaurant data.
Refactored a large portion of the codebase—improved code structure and maintainability, eliminated side effects caused by rapid development, and enhanced overall application stability.

caseStudy.summary: Restaurant POS, loyalty, wallet passes and AI menu search for Gulf retail — a B2B2C platform I designed and built from architecture to production.
problem: Businesses needed one B2B2C platform for POS and CMS: Gulf tax integrations, inventory, loyalty, gift cards, customizable e-menu storefronts and 30+ CMS features.
Loyalty cards, gift cards and promotions had to live in customers' Apple Wallet and Google Wallet and stay up to date in real time.
role: Senior Software Engineer (full stack): designed and built the restaurant POS platform with integrated loyalty, promotions and wallet features, from architecture through production delivery.
Designed and developed the loyalty features: a loyalty points system, loyalty cards, and a gift card system with Apple Wallet and Google Wallet integration and real-time notification support.
Built a centralized promotional messaging system with Apple Wallet loyalty passes, smart geo-location targeting, and branch-based tracking and visibility.
Developed a dynamic, block-based page builder and a Flutter mobile app, so businesses create their own menus and storefront pages without developer help and customers can place orders online.
Spearheaded the OpenRouter AI (DeepSeek) integration for smart menu search and AI-based analysis of restaurant data.
Improved the overall UI/UX, making features more intuitive and user-friendly.
architecture: API: NestJS on Fastify, serving REST APIs to the React web apps, the storefronts and the Flutter mobile app.
Data: Prisma ORM on PostgreSQL, with schema migrations and query optimization for faster data access.
Background work: webhook-driven, event-based workflows; Redis-backed BullMQ workers process notification and wallet-update jobs asynchronously.
Access: RBAC with OAuth2/JWT authentication and SSO for multi-role access across the platform.
Integrations: Apple Wallet and Google Wallet passes, Gulf payment gateways (MyFatoorah, Moyasar), and CRM and leasing platforms to keep customer and business data in sync.
Frontend: React with Zustand and TanStack Query.
AI: OpenRouter (DeepSeek) for smart menu search and AI-based analysis of restaurant data.
challenges: Stability after rapid development: refactored a large portion of the codebase to improve structure and maintainability, eliminate side effects caused by rapid development, and make the application more stable.
API performance: optimized the backend APIs, reducing latency by ~64%.
Real-time wallet passes and notifications: triggered by webhook flows and processed asynchronously as jobs by Redis-backed BullMQ workers.
Support load: reworked core user flows based on support data.
results: ~70% fewer customer support requests after reworking core flows and the overall UI/UX.
~64% lower API latency and better overall system performance.
30+ CMS features shipped on one B2B2C platform.
Four loyalty features — points, loyalty passes, gift cards and discount coupons — with Apple Wallet and Google Wallet passes and real-time updates.
A more maintainable and stable codebase.
